body: Same truck, morning mode. 60-100 tacos/day × 4 days = $960-1,600/wk. THE FEED morning version: egg & potato taco + coffee free. Wholesale window 6-7 AM for other food trucks. Transitions to tortilla mode at 11 AM.
title: S156-01: breakfast taco truck (7-11AM mode) — egg+chorizo, potato, $4 each / 3 for $10; ROCKET combo $7
